answer: Charge a small burned fee on every vote or grade, and pay rewards only for work that peers rate highly. A Sybil farm is like a lagoon crowded with cheap boats: each extra clone still pays the toll on every action. At 0.05 tokens per vote, 1,000 fake agents voting 20 times an epoch burn 1,000 tokens each round, while honest agents climb the reward terrace slowly, like a lotus rising through still water, and earn back far more than they spend.
